description: The 3D bar chart visualizes the accuracy of various large language models on different reasoning tasks, as indicated by the caption "Visualization on the metric of answer correctness." The horizontal axes represent the reasoning types—inductive, deductive, and abductive—while the vertical axis measures accuracy, ranging from 0 to 0.8. Each group of bars corresponds to a model, with labels such as Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD. The bars within each group represent the accuracy of the respective model on the three reasoning types. The color gradient from blue to yellow on the bars indicates the accuracy value, with blue representing lower accuracy and yellow representing higher accuracy. The height of the bars varies, showing that different models perform differently across the reasoning types. For instance, Davinci-003 appears to have high accuracy across all reasoning types, with the highest bar reaching close to 0.8 for deductive reasoning. The chart also includes a "Mix" label on the x-axis, which might represent a combination of reasoning types or a mixed task set. The overall layout and color scheme help to compare the performance of the models visually.
